sloka: शीतीकृत्य तु गात्राणि क्लान्तान् आश्वास्य वाजिनः ।तत्र स्नात्वा च पीत्वा च प्रायात् आदाय च उदकम् ॥२-७१-७॥
transliteration: śītīkṛtya tu gātrāṇi klāntān āśvāsya vājinaḥ ।tatra snātvā ca pītvā ca prāyāt ādāya ca udakam ॥2-71-7॥

translations.english: ﻿ The weary horses rested and cooled their bodies. And they bathed and drank. They set out again refreshed taking with them a store of water.
